title: Urbanisation-driven nocturnal warming amplification in the United Arab Emirates: analysis pipeline and derived results
description:
Analysis pipeline, derived results and figures for the manuscript “Urbanisation-driven nocturnal warming amplification: Evidence from the United Arab Emirates” (submitted to Urban Climate, 2026).

Station records, satellite land-surface temperature, built-up surface and morphology, ERA5-Land and NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 are combined over 1995-2024 to measure the nocturnal urban warming increment and to test its representation in the climate products used for heat assessment. Attribution rests on a coast-matched exposure-response and a matched conversion event study with a pre-conversion trend test. All resampling, bootstrap and permutation procedures use the fixed random seed 20260713.
